import pandas as pd
import json

# Load both CSV files
assay_a_path = INPUT_FILES['assay-A.csv']
assay_b_path = INPUT_FILES['assay-B.csv']

df_a = pd.read_csv(assay_a_path)
df_b = pd.read_csv(assay_b_path)

# Set compound_id as index for easier lookup
a_dict = dict(zip(df_a['compound_id'], df_a['ic50_uM']))
b_dict = dict(zip(df_b['compound_id'], df_b['ic50_uM']))

# Find common, only_in_a, and only_in_b
a_ids = set(a_dict.keys())
b_ids = set(b_dict.keys())

common_ids = sorted(a_ids & b_ids)
only_in_a_ids = sorted(a_ids - b_ids)
only_in_b_ids = sorted(b_ids - a_ids)

# Build common compounds list with delta calculation
common_compounds = []
for cid in common_ids:
    val_a = a_dict[cid]
    val_b = b_dict[cid]
    delta = val_b - val_a
    common_compounds.append({
        "compound_id": cid,
        "file_a_uM": val_a,
        "file_b_uM": val_b,
        "delta_B_minus_A_uM": delta
    })

# Build result JSON
result = {
    "common": common_compounds,
    "only_in_a": only_in_a_ids,
    "only_in_b": only_in_b_ids
}

print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
